blocks.title: Unit testing
blocks.text: Unit testing testing ki pehli satah hai: alag alag hisse ya modules akele test hote hain. Har unit software ka chhota, test hone qabil hissa hai, jaise function ya method, aur maqsad yeh jaanchna hai ke har ek apne design ke mutabiq theek kaam kare.
Class activity: apni pasandeeda programming language mein kisi saade function ka unit test likhne ki koshish karein.

blocks.prompt: add(a, b) function jo jama lautaye, us ka unit test kya jaanchega?
blocks.explanation: Yeh function ko akele maloom inputs ke saath chala kar nateeja tawaqqo shuda jawab se milata hai, maslan add(2, 3) ka 5 aur add(-1, 1) ka 0 aana chahiye; koi nateeja mukhtalif ho to unit mein bug hai.

items: Unit testing: pehli satah; har chhoti unit (function ya method) apne design ke muqable akele test.
